cases.expected: All validators' preloadJsonSchema() methods are invoked exactly once and JsonSchema.validatorsLoaded becomes true
cases.description: When validatorsLoaded is false, initializeValidators() should iterate over the list returned by getValidators(), call preloadJsonSchema() on each validator, and finally set validatorsLoaded to true.

cases.expected: preloadJsonSchema() is not invoked for any validator and validatorsLoaded remains true
cases.description: When validatorsLoaded is already true, initializeValidators() must skip the preload loop entirely and leave the flag unchanged.

cases.expected: RuntimeException is propagated; preloadJsonSchema() is invoked on the first validator, the exception aborts the method, and validatorsLoaded stays false
cases.description: If a validator throws an exception during preload, initializeValidators() should not set validatorsLoaded to true, allowing a retry on a later call.

cases.expected: preloadJsonSchema() is not invoked for any validator and validatorsLoaded becomes true
cases.description: When getValidators() returns an empty list and validatorsLoaded is false, the method should skip the loop, not call any preload, and set validatorsLoaded to true.

cases.expected: RuntimeException is propagated; preloadJsonSchema() is invoked on the first validator, then on the second which throws, validatorsLoaded stays false and the third validator is never invoked
cases.description: With multiple validators, if a validator in the middle throws an exception, the method must abort, propagate the exception, leave validatorsLoaded false, and ensure no further validators are processed.

cases.expected: On first call, RuntimeException is thrown and validatorsLoaded remains false; on second call, all validators' preloadJsonSchema() are invoked and validatorsLoaded becomes true
cases.description: Verifies that after a failed preload attempt the flag is not set, allowing a subsequent call to retry loading all validators successfully.

cases.expected: preloadJsonSchema() is invoked exactly once per validator even when two threads call initializeValidators() simultaneously; validatorsLoaded ends true
cases.description: Simulates two concurrent invocations when validatorsLoaded is initially false to ensure the method behaves correctly (no double‑loading) and ends with validatorsLoaded true. (Implementation may rely on external synchronization; test asserts that only one set of preload calls occurs.)

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown; validatorsLoaded remains false
cases.description: When getValidators() returns null, the for‑each loop attempts to iterate over a null reference, causing a NullPointerException before any preload is attempted. The validatorsLoaded flag must stay false so a later retry can succeed.
